# Northstar Outfitters Gift Wrapping Policy

> Fictional demo content for Knowbase AI. Northstar Outfitters is not a real company.

## Gift wrapping

Gift wrapping costs $5 per item and is available for orders placed by 20 December.
Wrapped items ship in a plain outer box so the gift stays a surprise.
